DIPANJAN DE Solutions Architect | Principal Engineer | AI Platform Architect Chennai, India | +91-8013758776 | dipanjan131@gmail.com | LinkedIn | GitHub

Notice Period: 30 Days | Open to Remote & Hybrid (Bangalore / Chennai)

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Solutions Architect and Principal Engineer with 8+ years architecting scalable, AI-powered, multi-tenant SaaS and enterprise platforms across Healthcare, ERP, and EdTech. Proven record of designing cloud-native systems on AWS, integrating GenAI and LLM workflows into production, and translating complex business problems into measurable outcomes — including 95% faster onboarding, 50% reduction in technical debt, and €3M+ in enterprise contracts. Founder of an AI-driven, multi-tenant no-code platform with live enterprise customers. Skilled at leading cross-functional teams, defining technical strategy, and bridging engineering execution with business value.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Architecture: Solutions Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Platform Architecture, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Multi-Tenant SaaS, Distributed Systems, Domain-Driven Design, System Design, API Design, Message Queues (Kafka / SQS), Scalability, High Availability, Fault Tolerance, Design Patterns AI / GenAI / LLM: LLM Integration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangChain, Vector Databases / Embeddings, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI / ChatGPT, Google Gemini, HuggingFace, Prompt Engineering, AI Workflow Automation, MLOps, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Neural Networks, TensorFlow, AWS Textract / Bedrock, Computer Vision Cloud & DevOps: AWS (Lambda, Aurora, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, Step Functions, ECS, EKS, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, Bedrock), Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, OpenTofu / Terraform, Pulumi, SST, Docker, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Serverless, FinOps / Cloud Cost Optimization Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Node.js, SQL, Go (familiar), HTML, CSS / SCSS Backend: Node, Express, tRPC, FastAPI, Flask, Django, Laravel, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets, Webhooks, Microservices, API Gateway Frontend: React, Vue, Svelte, Nuxt, Next.js, PWA, Design Systems, Component Libraries, Micro-Frontends Data: PostgreSQL, Aurora, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, Neo4j, Firestore, Row-Level Security, Data Modeling, ETL, Data Pipelines Security & Compliance: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, RBAC, SSO, Zero Trust, Encryption at Rest / in Transit, GDPR, India DPDP Act, SOC 2 (familiar), Data Residency, Audit & Consent Architecture, Secure SDLC Healthcare: FHIR, HL7 v2, SMART on FHIR, Structured Data Capture (SDC), Interoperability, Clinical Data, PHI / PII Handling Observability: Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus, Mimir, OpenTelemetry, Distributed Tracing, Monitoring, SRE Practices, SLAs / SLOs Methodology & Leadership: Technical Leadership, Team Leadership, People Management, Mentoring, Stakeholder Management, Pre-Sales / Solution Consulting, Roadmap Ownership, Technical Strategy, Agile / Scrum, ADRs, C4 Model, Cross- Functional Collaboration

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Principal Engineer | Tricon Infotech Enterprise SaaS · Lead Insights platform · AWS cloud-native architecture

Jun 2025 – Present

Architected and built a fully automated, multi-tenant tenant-onboarding service on AWS for the core product (LeadInsights), reducing onboarding time by 95% from hours to minutes through idempotent, Infrastructure-as-Code provisioning (OpenTofu).

Designed jurisdiction-aware regional cluster architecture with data residency enforced at the infrastructure layer, ensuring GDPR and India DPDP compliance by design rather than by policy.

Defined a component-ownership team strategy that increased accountability for critical services and reduced issue- resolution time by 30%.

Engineered isolated, region-scoped observability (Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, Mimir, Tempo) eliminating cross-border data exposure and improving incident diagnosis.

Founder & Platform Architect | Logiforma AI-powered, multi-tenant no-code SaaS / PaaS · Live enterprise retail customers

2024 – Present

• Founded and architected an AI-powered, multi-tenant no-code workflow automation platform serving live enterprise

retail clients, with automated tenant onboarding, ERP integration, and AI-driven workflow steps.

Built AI-powered workflow steps (Summarize, Classify, Extract, Transform) with structured-output enforcement and full audit logging, plus AI-generated summaries in dynamic data tables — integrating LLMs into production enterprise workflows.

Designed a visual workflow engine on a typed directed-graph model with idempotent execution, partial-failure recovery, and versioned definitions for auditability.

Delivered deep ERP integration with Infor M3 via a normalized adapter layer handling authentication, error normalization, retry logic, and full interaction audit trails.

Implemented multi-tenant data isolation using PostgreSQL Row-Level Security and per-tenant schemas, enforcing tenant boundaries at the database engine level.

Technical Lead | Vince AS EdTech · Flagship product · Cross-functional leadership

Apr 2023 – Jun 2025

Led a cross-functional team (engineering, product, design) to deliver the next-generation flagship product, boosting revenue by 25% and improving user satisfaction by 50%.

Architected and built the company's first design system (30+ reusable components), cutting development time by 30% and standardizing UX across products.

UI Architect | Karkinos Healthcare HealthTech · FHIR-based clinical data platform

Feb 2022 – Mar 2023

Architected and led development of a FHIR-based Structured Data Capture (SDC) platform with fully customizable questionnaires, API-driven sharing, full RBAC, and OCR pipelines — reducing form-processing time by 50%.

Designed and built a B2B cancer registry with dynamic patient flowsheets and custom visualization tools, successfully onboarding 20+ enterprise B2B clients.

Built a custom FHIR Questionnaire rendering engine with FHIRPath-based conditional logic and discrete data extraction, exceeding the clinical UX bar of generic implementations.

Senior Software Engineer | Philips HealthTech · Patient scheduling & population health · Enterprise contracts

Aug 2018 – Jan 2022

Architected and led development of patient scheduling systems, population-health dashboards, and award-winning prototypes that secured high-value enterprise contracts worth €3M+.

Designed FHIR-compliant UIs, migrated legacy systems, and reduced technical debt by 50% on a mission-critical scheduling platform serving multiple appointment types.

Software Engineering Intern | Vodafone

May 2015 – Jun 2015

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Reduced enterprise tenant onboarding time by 95% via automated, IaC-driven multi-tenant provisioning on AWS. • Secured €3M+ in enterprise contracts through architecture and prototypes at Philips. • Founder of a live, revenue-generating AI-powered multi-tenant SaaS platform with enterprise customers. • Mentored 100+ engineers across 10+ countries (ADPList); Industrial Expert Faculty at Vijaybhoomi University (9.1/10 rating); Speaker at VueJS & JavaScript Global Summits (2021–2025); Philips Excellence Awards.

PERSONAL PROJECTS

Ecosphere Design System — Component library (Vue / Nuxt plugin) with theming, design tokens, and i18n for design- to-code handoff.

JustTransact (Web3 dApp) — Secure Ethereum transaction dApp with MetaMask integration for global peer-to-peer transfers.

HL7 Connectathon Platform — Full-stack event management platform for HL7 India with registration, RBAC, and Razorpay payments via webhooks.

EDUCATION

M.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering — Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), Vellore B.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering — SRM University, Kattankulathur

2017 – 2019 2013 – 2017
